newsitem.title: CHILE: UPS buys express unit of Chilean contractor.
newsitem.headline: UPS buys express unit of Chilean contractor.

text.p: United Parcel Service on Monday said it has bought the international express division of Air Courier Ltd, its authorized contractor in Chile, for an undisclosed price.
Privately held UPS said the purchase strengthens its presence in South America and will pave the way for expanded service and further integration of its worldwide network.

Under the new arrangement, UPS said it will directly handle international express services to major business centers in Chile through five daily flights into Santiago. Air Courier will handle UPS deliveries in outer areas, it said.
UPS said it now handles pickup and delivery of more than 6 million packages and documents a year in Latin America and the Caribbean. Volume has grown at an annual rate of 25 percent.
UPS said it began operations with Air Courier in 1991. It initiated its push into Latin America in 1989, with the establishment of express service to Mexico, it said.
